summary.zh: 候选收件箱新增条件、目的、不适用与关系备注（缺失仅警告），采纳写入的规则行与 OPINION.md 框架随项目文件语言；en 项目的锁带 language，旧运行时读不了。
summary.en: The candidate inbox gains trigger, purpose, exclusion and relation fields (missing ones only warn); the rule line and OPINION.md frame written on adopt follow the project file language. The lock of an en project carries language, which older runtimes cannot read.
